'''Brian Canady''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 61st, 2 (−72) after six games at [[RamapoCon II]] on 6 May 2000, according to Scott Lingrell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d741">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-ramapocon-ii-day-2-director-s-reportd741/ ramapocon-ii-day-2-director-s-report], DeckTech (Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell, 13 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-13-ramapocon-ii-day-2-director-s-reportd741/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
